prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0002",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 28,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00688-00689",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "珍しい物を見る様に俺の顔を見ているリンシャに、\nシュリが困ったように声を掛けた。",
      "en": "Rinsha eyes me like a rarity. Troubled, Shuri speaks up."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00695-00696",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ん、ああ、そうそう、うちは前払いだけどいい？",
      "en": "Ah, right. We need payment upfront. That okay?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00702-00703",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、おいくらでしょう",
      "en": "Yes, how much will that be?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00709-00710",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "二部屋で一週間だから……１４０シリンね",
      "en": "Two rooms for a week... that will be 140 shillings."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00716-00716",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "路銀の入った袋を開いていたシュリの手が瞬時にして凍り付く。",
      "en": "Shuri's hand froze as she opened the money pouch."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00722-00723",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "どうしたの？",
      "en": "What's the matter?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00729-00730",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "シリン……ですか……",
      "en": "Shillings...?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00736-00737",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "そうよ……あっ！　もしかして持ってないの？",
      "en": "Right... Ah! Could it be you do not have them?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00743-00744",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、此処に来る迄はルドラで払えたので……",
      "en": "Yes, we could pay with Rudra until we got here, so..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00746-00747",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言えばレウィニアを出発する際にレヴィアが\nこの街では扱っている通貨が違うと言っていたような……。",
      "en": "Now that I think about it, when we left Lewinia, Levia mentioned that this city uses a different currency..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00753-00754",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あらー、この街じゃあルドラは使えないわよ",
      "en": "Oh dear, Rudra isn't accepted in this town."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00760-00761",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "私、換金してきます",
      "en": "I will go exchange it."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00767-00768",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "無理よ",
      "en": "No way."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00774-00775",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "えっ？",
      "en": "Huh?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00781-00784",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "三日前にレウィニアの軍隊が来てね、\nその人達がみんなして換金したものだから、\n換金所の金庫がルドラだらけになっちゃったのよ",
      "en": "Three days ago, the Lewinian army came, and they all exchanged their money, so the exchange office vault is now overflowing with Rudra."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00790-00791",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "ええ！",
      "en": "What?!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00797-00799",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで昨日換金所の人達全員、\n他の街で換金して来るって言って、出て行っちゃったのよ",
      "en": "So yesterday, the exchange office folks all went off to other towns to exchange, and now there's no one."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00805-00806",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "そんな……",
      "en": "No way..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00808-00809",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺は狼狽えているシュリの肩に手を置くと、\n店のリンシャの前に進み出た。",
      "en": "Shuri was flustered. I placed a hand on her shoulder and stepped forward to Rinsha."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00811-00812",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、御主人様……",
      "en": "Ah, Master..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00814-00815",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "これで、支払えないか？",
      "en": "Can we pay with this?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00817-00817",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺は内懐から取り出した宝石を無造作に差し出した。",
      "en": "I casually offered a gem from my inside pocket."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00823-00824",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "何これ？　まさか宝石？",
      "en": "What's this? Could it be a gem?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:00826-00830",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "彼女が不思議に思うのも無理はない、血よりも赤く、\n曇り一つ無く澄んだ輝きを放つその宝石は、\n見開かれた彼女の瞳よりも大きい。\n確か、人が一年は遊んで暮らせるくらいの価値があった筈だが。",
      "en": "It's no wonder she's puzzled. The gem, redder than blood and flawlessly clear, is larger than her wide eyes. It was worth a year's leisurely living, I believe."
    }
  ]
}
